title: Shovel3x3
description: A vanilla-style 3x3 netherite shovel datapack for faster digging in Minecraft 26.2.
body:
This datapack uses vanilla commands to break the extra blocks, so some plugin-based systems may only detect the first block broken by the player.

Emerald 3x3 Shovel

Emerald 3x3 Shovel is a vanilla-style datapack that adds a special netherite shovel capable of digging blocks in a 3x3 area.

This datapack is designed for Minecraft / Paper 26.2 and does not require any mods or plugins.

Features

- Adds a custom 3x3 netherite shovel
- Digs compatible shovel blocks in a 3x3 area
- Uses vanilla datapack commands
- Includes an enchantment glint effect
- Does not change vanilla textures
- Works separately from normal netherite shovels

Commands

Give yourself the shovel:

mcfunction
/function shovel3x3:give
